name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No Atlantic tropical cyclones active on 11 Nov and none expected to form over the next seven days, per NHC
state: The National Hurricane Center's tropical weather outlook issued on 11 Nov reported no tropical cyclones in the Atlantic, Caribbean or Gulf and no formation expected over the next seven days (NHC). With no storm threatening land, the signal stays Normal; the season formally ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: No Atlantic storm currently threatens land. Travellers to the Caribbean or US Gulf coast can check National Hurricane Center outlooks and FCDO travel advice until the season ends on 30 Nov.
rubric_hit: No hurricane active and none threatening land within 5 days (NHC outlook, 11 Nov)

sources.title: NOAA National Hurricane Center — Atlantic tropical weather outlook

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).

rubric.alert: Category 3+ landfall expected within 72 hours or occurring.
rubric.watch: Tropical storm or hurricane threatening land within 5 days.
